thread:
Priya: heads-up — a customer hit a 413 on /v1/embeddings when they sent mixed-dim arrays. they send a batch of 3, two are 768 and one is 1024. 413 from splitter. :grimacing:
Alex: ugh. that's been a recurring edge. do we currently require all vectors to be same dim for batch path?
Jamal: yes for the fast path. splitter assumes homogenous dims to map to shard pools. heterogeneous gets rejected upstream to avoid silent corruption.
Priya: understood, but customer expects graceful fallback — split into two requests automatically or route to single-request path. can we do that without exploding cost/latency?
Megan: proposal: accept mixed dims but run a preflight quick-pass that returns a routing plan in response header `X-Embed-Plan: splits=2; dims=768,1024` so SDK can auto-retry split. less server work and predictable billing.
Alex: i like explicit plan. also add `X-Embed-Estimated-Units` so console shows cost estimate preflight. UX wins.
Jamal: tricky: preflight means extra RPC for every first-of-batch; it could double QPS for small requests. we can make it opt-in per-tenant via `prefetch=true` flag in request, and we offer a server-side heuristic for auto-splitting when batch_len > N.
Priya: agree on opt-in. customers with high throughput can enable `batch-autosplit=on` in console. for others, SDK could do a cheap client-side check.
Luis: two implementation questions: 1) how do we expose the split policy in console? 2) telemetry: how do we count an autosplit as one request vs two for quota?
Megan: telemetry: emit `embed.split.occurrence` with tags `orig_count`, `final_requests`, `policy=auto|sdk|reject`. Quota should bill by final token/vector count — but annotate original request id so we can reconcile.
Alex: console surface: in model route config add toggle `Autosplit mixed dims` with dropdown: `off`, `sdk-only`, `auto`. default `sdk-only`. show estimated units delta and a quick inline explainer.
Jamal: backend route change: add `shape-hints` header detection, fallback path that does per-dim batching using existing splitter code. we can reuse current splitter but only trigger when `batch-autosplit=on` or `prefetch=true` returns plan.
Priya: need a rollout plan: start with canary customers who opt in, then gradual 10/30/100. also add regression alerts on latency and token cost per request.
Megan: i'll add metrics: `embed.prefilter.duration`, `embed.autosplit.latency.p95`, `embed.autosplit.cost_delta` and create dashboard tiles. link to early mock: https://console.redwood/embeds/autosplit-mock (internal).
Alex: SDK change: we add client-side preflight validator that inspects `inputs` and either splits locally or hits `/v1/embeddings?prefetch=true`. we need clear error semantics: if server rejects, return 413 with body {"error":"mixed_dims_reject","hint":"use autosplit or normalize dims"}.
Luis: compatibility: some customers send base64 blobs or mixed payload formats. we should add a lightweight preflight that just reads shape header `X-Embed-Shape` if present to avoid parsing full payload. example: `X-Embed-Shape: 768` or `X-Embed-Shape: mixed`
Jamal: good idea. also respect `Prefer: respond-async` from clients. async path for huge splits.
Priya: next steps: jamal to prototype server-side split heuristic + header handling, alex to draft SDK preflight + client split, megan to add telemetry and console toggle mocks. luis to do billing reconciliation logic. I'll own the rollout doc and canary list.
deploy-bot: @Priya started deployment pipeline for `embed-autosplit-prototype` to canary infra (canary-1). status: queued. :gear:
Priya: thanks — please add a note in the canary runbook to watch `embed.autosplit.latency.p95` and `embed.split.occurrence` spikes.
Alex: quick snippet for SDK doc to illustrate header check:
```
// JS example preflight
const shapes = inputs.map(v => v.shape || v.headers['x-embed-shape']);
if (new Set(shapes).size > 1) {
  // either split locally or call preflight endpoint
}
```
Megan: added a checklist in the design doc: telemetry, console toggle, SDK opt-in, canary gating. I'll post link in #eng-platform once ready. :+1: 
Priya: solid. capture open question: quota semantics (count final vs initial) and cost messaging in console. will sync with billing next week.
Luis: noted. i'll prepare reconciliation PR for billing logic.
Priya: thanks all — keeping this thread for rollout notes. ping me if you want to join the canary list. :eyes:
